answer: Pay rewards through task-diversity decay: each epoch's payout is multiplied down when an identity's work repeats the same shape as its own past output or its peers', like a basalt cliff where every pulse of the same hollow echo fades. A lone agent mixing real tasks keeps full weight. A farm running one script across a thousand fakes earns a geometrically shrinking share per clone, because repetition itself becomes the tax and copying the same work no longer pays.
